summary: Medalist Diversified, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting the September 17, 2026 closing of its acquisition of a Caliber Collision Center at 8600 Highway 377, Aubrey, Texas, from NPH Ventures, LLC, an unaffiliated seller. The property spans roughly 1.653 acres with a 15,118-square-foot automotive service building. Total purchase price was $5,404,864, funded from cash on hand; the agreement, signed July 21, 2026, was terminated August 18, 2026, then reinstated and amended September 3, 2026. The company acquired through a Delaware statutory trust and expects a Reg D private placement of beneficial interests to accredited investors, redeeming its interests for cash. Watch DST offering execution and asset-level returns.
